blocks.h2: Shower Repairs in Hanover Park Homes
blocks.intro: Many bathrooms here still have original valves.

items.body: Valves from the '70s and '80s wear out and don't balance pressure.
A cracked base can leak into the ceiling below.
Leaks show up on the first-floor ceiling.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Fix it without tearing out the wall where we can.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: If your shower still has the valve that came with the house, a replacement can solve several problems at once. A pressure-balancing or thermostatic valve keeps the temperature steady when someone flushes or starts the dishwasher. A new cartridge-style valve is easier to repair later. With a fiberglass surround, we can often reach the valve from an access panel or from the room behind, so you don't have to replace the whole unit.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: A cartridge swap is usually quick. Replacing an original valve takes longer, especially with a fiberglass surround. Leak testing adds time when the source isn't obvious. We diagnose and quote a flat price before work starts.

blocks.h2: Shower Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Why does my shower turn hot when someone flushes?
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure. A new pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.q: Can you replace a valve without tearing out the tub surround?
items.answer: Often. We work from behind the trim or through an access panel.

items.q: Is my shower leaking into the ceiling?
items.preview: We'll test the valve, drain and tub.
items.answer: We test the valve, the drain and the tub or base to find the source.

items.q: Why is my shower pressure low?
items.preview: Usually a clogged showerhead or cartridge.
items.answer: Usually a clogged showerhead or cartridge.

items.q: Can you fix a tub spout that sprays when the shower is on?
items.answer: Yes. The diverter in the spout is usually worn. A new spout fixes it.

items.q: Can you replace a fiberglass tub and shower unit?
items.answer: We handle the plumbing for the new unit. A remodeler or installer handles the surround.

items.q: Why is there water outside my shower after use?
items.preview: Often a worn door seal or caulk.
items.answer: Often a worn door seal or caulk, not the plumbing. We'll check the valve and drain to be sure.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
